_readme: Recorded deviations of other units. A failure that matches a `known` entry (same kind, method, path regex) is printed on every run and does not fail the gate; the unit that fixes it deletes its entry (an entry that matches nothing is reported as stale). binary / redirect / emptyError describe routes whose non-JSON answer is by design.

binary.note: node installer scripts and the daemon jar with checksum
widget loader script, a JavaScript file by design

redirect.note: content-hash redirect to the same path
avatar redirect to the skin service
maintenance forms redirect to the site

emptyError.note: image and file routes answer a status-only 404
plugin image and file routes answer a status-only 404
gateway callbacks and return pages answer a status-only 404 for an unknown provider
